title: A0 French sounds (special)
subtitle: Small chunks you can master fast.

cards.title: Clusters: br / cr / dr / fr / gr / pr / tr
cards.fr: Practice: br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr
cards.note: Keep it smooth: one breath → one cluster.

cards.title: È / Ê (accent grave / circonflexe) = ‘eh’
cards.note: Often more open than é. Listen for ‘eh’.

cards.title: À (accent grave) = same sound as a
cards.note: Accent marks the word (often grammar), not a new sound here.

cards.title: Ç (c cédille) = ‘s’
cards.note: ç makes c sound like s before a/o/u.

cards.title: J (soft ‘zh’)
cards.note: It’s like the ‘s’ in ‘measure’ (English), a soft ‘zh’.

cards.title: V (stronger than English v)
cards.note: Keep the lower lip on upper teeth: vvvvv.

cards.title: Y (two sounds)
cards.note: Y changes depending on the word — don’t overthink, imitate.
